mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT rr.res_id FROM sys_role_res rr JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rr.role_id AND ur.deleted = FALSE JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = TRUE JOIN t_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.tenant_id = r.tenant_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND rr.deleted = FALSE AND u.deleted = FALSE
